name: Times cryptic crossword, Times Crosswords book 1 No 112

clue.text: Bargain on standard vegetable

Shameless farce, with a terribly wearing plot
Observes guards

Non-stop flight?

Spice chapter with passion

Particular honour
One escaped from Slough, another went to Kent

Comparatively attractive name Eric changed
Diatribe from Greek character with sauce and endless pluck
Same number from North and South meeting in the middle, in principle

Adversary in Troy Menelaus upset
